data.description: A xenopterid can produce a sticky, slimy secretion it uses to protect its territory and eggs. The xenopterid can slime up to a 10-foot-square area per day at a rate of 1 square foot per minute. For 1 week thereafter, any creature coming in direct contact with the slime must succeed at a DC %1 Strength check or be entangled and glued to it as if it had failed its save against a tanglefoot bag.
data.name: Entangling Slime
